home.title: Music from Liberia and Africa, in one place.
home.body: Emerg Music is being built in the open. Accounts and profiles work today. The catalog, player and Artist Studio arrive in the next phases.
home.status: Status: foundation phase. Streaming is not live yet.
home.sub: Music from Liberia and Africa, ready to play.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Check your details and try again.

profile.name: Name
profile.privacy: Your email stays private. Only your name and photo can appear on your public profile.

player.unavailable: This track has no audio available yet.

catalog.emptyBody: Releases appear here after an approved artist publishes them and an admin approves them. Nothing here is placeholder content.

studio.title: Artist Studio
studio.applyTitle: Apply to publish on Emerg Music
studio.applyIntro: Tell us who you are. An admin reviews every application before you can publish. You may only upload music you own or are authorized to distribute.
studio.links: Links to your music or social pages (one per line)
studio.accept: I confirm the information is true and I will only upload music I have the rights to.
studio.applied: Application sent. We will review it.
studio.playsNote: Counted from signed-in listeners after 30 seconds. No estimates.
studio.audioNote: Upload only audio you own or are licensed to release. A release cannot be played until audio is attached to its tracks.
studio.submitted: Submitted. An admin will review this release.
studio.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check the details and try again.
studio.errorRights: You must accept the rights declaration.
studio.errorNoTracks: Add at least one track first.
studio.monetization: About earnings: Emerg Music is free to stream at launch. We do not promise any payment per stream. A transparent revenue-sharing policy will be published before any payouts begin, with auditable records and fraud checks.

errors.type: Use MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC or OGG.
errors.config: Audio storage is not configured yet.
errors.auth: You can't upload to this track.
errors.notfound: Track not found or no longer a draft.
errors.denied: Storage refused the file. Check the R2 token (needs Object Read & Write on emerg-audio).
errors.network: Browser was blocked from reaching storage. Check the R2 CORS policy.
errors.save: File uploaded but could not be saved to the track. Try again.

upload.imageTypeError: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
upload.optimizeFailed: Uploaded. Optimization failed, the original will play.

studio.errorNoAudio: Every track needs audio before you can submit.
studio.errorGenre: Choose a genre for the track.
studio.coverHint: Square JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 1000 × 1000 px, up to 5 MB. It appears on your release and in shared links.
studio.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. It appears on your artist page and in shared links.

wizard.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection.
wizard.genreHint: Listeners browse by genre. Pick the one that fits best.
wizard.artworkHint: Square JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 1000 × 1000 px, up to 5 MB. It appears on your release and in shared links.
wizard.needStep1: Add a title, type, genre, language and artwork to continue.
wizard.needStep2: Every track needs a title and an audio file to continue.
wizard.explicitHint: Turn on if this track has strong language or adult themes.
wizard.limitReached: You have reached the track limit for this release type.
wizard.audioHint: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG, up to 100 MB. Upload the best quality you have. We also make a lighter version for slow networks.
wizard.optimizedFailed: Audio uploaded · optimization failed, the original will play
wizard.reviewIntro: Check everything before you submit. Our team reviews every release before it goes live.
wizard.nextBody: Draft, then In review, then Published. After you submit, you can't edit the release until it is reviewed.
wizard.confirmDelete: Delete this draft release and its tracks?
wizard.submittedBody: Thank you. An admin will review this release. Once it is published it appears on your artist page.
